verdict.rationale: Replit documents a first-party Replit MCP Server. A compatible external client can connect to it to create, find, inspect, or update Replit Apps, so an outside agent can drive Replit through an official MCP server. The Agent's own ability to connect to other MCP servers is client-side and is not credited here. missing for 10: details on the tool surface, auth and setup flow, and supported clients, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works.
